title: Canonical continuous coefficient realizations commute with ring maps
statement: Let X be a scheme and E,F be topological rings in Type 0. The canonical morphism from the condensed continuous E coefficient object pulled to X to the sheaf U↦C(U,E) is an actual adjoint of composition with the profinite test projection. It is a monoid morphism and, for totally disconnected E, is an isomorphism. For a continuous ring map φ:E→F, this comparison intertwines the pulled condensed coefficient map with postcomposition of continuous functions by φ. In particular the integral-to-field comparison square commutes.

proof.text: Construct the adjoint map explicitly on profinite test sections by composition with the canonical profinite test projection. Its naturality follows from the projection formula. The corresponding ring-valued map shows it is a monoid homomorphism. The monoidal adjunction transfers this property to the actual comparison.

For totally disconnected coefficients, the already proved Type-0 comparison in IntegralScalarContractive is definitionally this actual construction. Its isomorphism theorem supplies the instance; nonarchimedean field extensions and their integer subrings satisfy the required total disconnectedness.

Apply the inverse-image/direct-image Hom equivalence to the two composites for φ. Its naturality on both sides reduces the assertion to equality on profinite test sections. Both composites apply φ pointwise after composition with the test projection, so they are equal.

lemma chartComparison_naturality (X : Scheme.{u})
    (E F : Type) [TopologicalSpace E] [Ring E] [IsTopologicalRing E]
    [TopologicalSpace F] [Ring F] [IsTopologicalRing F]
    (φ : E →+* F) (hφ : Continuous φ) :
    (upperStarFromPoint X).map
        ((sheafCompose (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
          (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map
            (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ)) ≫ chartComparison X F =
      chartComparison X E ≫ (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map
          (continuousMapRingSheafMap X φ hφ)
